title: St John Street Police Station Visit – Crime Number Confusion & Start Date Manipulation
summary: In-person visit to Sussex Police St John Street front desk (Liz). Confirms 4 crime numbers, start date shifted from 2 Nov to 18 Nov, OIC swaps without notification, VRR blocked, and silence since April 6 suicide attempt.

segments.quote: Liz confirmed 4 crime numbers are active; one was improperly filed without follow-up.
Case dates are being manipulated: police now claim my first report was 18 November 2024, when I have evidence it was 2 November (‘X Won’t Leave Me Alone’ – NICE link).
Liz acknowledged no officer has responded since my April 6 suicide attempt.
I explicitly requested help lodging my Victim’s Right to Review. Liz confirmed this could not be done at the desk and that I needed to speak to my OIC — who has never called me since April.
Sergeant Duffy is supervising PC Gasson, just as he did with PC Dixon — the officer who failed to log my suicide.
